name: Stitch Obby
desc:
🌟 Discover 125 Stages!

✨ Don't forget to hit the Like, Favorite, and Follow buttons to show your support for the game!

🌊 Are you ready to test your parkour skills in an exciting challenge? Welcome to Easy 125 Stages Parkour Obby, where you'll need to overcome 125 fun and easy stages to reach the finish line. Navigate through unexpected obstacles, use your parkour skills to reach new heights, and have fun in a vibrant world full of adventure!

💙 Don't forget to support the game by leaving a Like and adding it to your Favorites so we can bring you even more updates!
